title: Derived self-tensor for a flat surjection
statement: Let $A\to B$ be a surjective homomorphism of commutative rings such that $B$ is flat as an $A$-module. Then the canonical multiplication morphism $B\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}B\to B[0]$ is an isomorphism in the derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category].

source.place: Tag 08R2 (lemma-when-zero), cases (1)--(2): a flat epimorphism is a special case of the flat diagonal case; the derived tensor is represented by the ordinary tensor under flatness

proof.text: Regard B as the A-module M obtained by restriction along f. The hypothesis f.Flat is exactly Module.Flat A M. The proved library equivalence ModuleCat.flat_iff_flat expresses flat tensor exactness [lem-weil-pbc-flat-tensor-exact] categorically. Apply CochainComplex.kFlat_single_obj_iff_flat to obtain K-flatness [def-pc-module-kflat-complex] of the degree-zero complex E=M[0].

Take T and its comparison ε from the same nested Classical.choose terms used by derivedSelfTensorMultiplication. Clause (2) of [lem-pc-derived-tensor-second-factor-functor] supplies IsIso ((ε N).app E) for E=M[0] and N=B[0], by the K-flatness of Step 1. The remaining factors in the definition are the canonical single-complex tensor isomorphism, the single/map isomorphism, and single applied to the left unitor followed by the extension/restriction counit.

source.place: Tag 06Y6 (lemma-derived-base-change), construction immediately before the lemma, with the identity K-flat resolution

proof.text: Restriction of scalars along f is fully faithful. Faithfulness is the standard ModuleCat instance. For fullness, take any A-linear map g between B-modules. It is additive, and for b in B choose a in A with f(a)=b by surjectivity; the required equation g(b • x)=b • g(x) is precisely A-linearity of g at a. Thus g is B-linear and restricts back to the given map. The standard fully faithful right-adjoint theorem now makes the counit of ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj f invertible. This is exactly ordinary multiplication on B ⊗_A B, with the stated B-action [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product]; equivalently its inverse sends b to 1 ⊗ b.

source.place: Tag 00CX (lemma-tensor-product), universal property and balanced tensor relations; explicit surjection calculation

proof.text: The left unitor, both canonical complex identifications, and the extension/restriction counit of Step 3 are isomorphisms. The single-complex functor and the localization Q [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] preserve isomorphisms. Consequently Q applied to their composite is invertible. Compose with the invertible comparison of Step 2 to obtain IsIso (derivedSelfTensorMultiplication f).

source.place: Tag 06Y6 (lemma-derived-base-change), K-flat model; concluding inverse equations

proof_origin.place: Tags 06XZ and 06Y6; ordinary multiplication from cotangent.tex Tag 08R2, expressed by full faithfulness of restriction along a surjection and the extension/restriction adjunction counit. Lean proof by Q9, 2026-10-23.
